name: TVer(ティーバー) 民放公式テレビ配信サービス

sources.label: Morphe patch for TVer
sources.author: yuubinnkyoku TVer
patch_list: Automatically enter system PiP for replay episodes; excludes paused episodes and home previews.
Experimental transparent WebView with offline test comments and episode playback synchronization.
Choose available video resolutions from a list (Auto, 1080p, 720p, etc.) and allow 1080p on phones for regular VOD.
Experimentally suppress selected player ad requests and hooks; full ad blocking is not guaranteed.
